convention: Vacuum wavelength_nm; passive n+i*k; epsilon_r=(n+i*k)^2; isotropic mu_r=1

air.description: Vacuum approximation to air, demonstration background
air.source: Model assumption, not a measurement of ambient air

silica.description: Fused silica at 20 C. k=0 is a transparent-material approximation; this is not an absorption spectrum. Do not use near infrared absorption bands without measured k.
silica.source: I. H. Malitson (1965), JOSA 55, 1205-1208; C. Z. Tan (1998) verifies formula to 6.7 um

silicon.description: Intrinsic crystalline Si at 300 K. k represents band-to-band absorption; doping, free carriers, amorphous Si and process films need different data.
silicon.interpolation: Linear interpolation of n and k; no extrapolation
silicon.source: M. A. Green (2008), Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells 92, 1305-1310
